about: Which PRs reach customers or production and so need a checker crew on a different model before firstmate_merge (owner decision Q8). Order: a repo row with reach internal is internal, whatever it changes. Otherwise an unreadable file list is production. Otherwise a changed file that matches productionPaths (shared or the repo row's own) is production. Otherwise a PR whose every changed file matches internalPaths is internal and self-checks, and anything else is production. A repo not listed here is not internal. A pattern ending in / is a folder at any depth; a leading / anchors it at the repo root. A pattern with a / that does not end in / is a full path, anchored at the root with a leading /. Any other pattern matches the file name. * is a wildcard. A repo name may use * too.
